INPERSON.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable Table Mode
INPERSON.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Master switch. While this is off, Foundry behaves exactly as usual.
INPERSON.Settings.DefaultPlayers.Name: Include players by default
INPERSON.Settings.DefaultPlayers.Hint: Any player without an explicit assignment in the controls runs in table mode. Gamemasters are never affected unless they opt in themselves.
INPERSON.Settings.Scope.Name: What gets blocked
INPERSON.Settings.Scope.Hint: Only the background map is the safe choice. Everything heavy saves more but may also hide something a player needs.
INPERSON.Settings.BlockAudio.Name: Block audio
INPERSON.Settings.BlockAudio.Hint: The devices load no music and no ambient sounds. Dice and notification sounds stay. Do not use together with Monk's Sound Enhancements.
INPERSON.Settings.AutoNoCanvas.Name: Switch the canvas off entirely in table mode
INPERSON.Settings.AutoNoCanvas.Hint: The device draws no canvas at all any more. That saves the most; the device reloads once for it.
INPERSON.Settings.AllowList.Name: Exceptions
INPERSON.Settings.AllowList.Hint: Path fragments that are never blocked - one per line or comma separated. Example: modules/my-map-assets/
INPERSON.Settings.Self.Name: This device: table mode
INPERSON.Settings.Self.Hint: Applies to this device only. An explicit assignment by the gamemaster always wins.
INPERSON.Panel.Title: Ninjo's In-Person Tools
INPERSON.Panel.MasterHint: Click to stop map downloads on the player clients.
INPERSON.Keybind.OpenPanel.Name: Open Table Mode controls
INPERSON.Keybind.OpenPanel.Hint: Opens the controls without going through the settings. Gamemasters only. Default is Alt+M - Ctrl+T will not work, the browser claims it for a new tab.
INPERSON.Panel.MeasureTooltip: Asks the server for headers only on every file of this scene and reads the file size. That transfers a few hundred bytes even for a 35 MB map. Results are stored, so a scene only needs measuring once.
INPERSON.Panel.CostTooltip: Total of all measured files of this scene, regardless of whether table mode is running. The two lines below split that figure into what gets blocked and what is loaded anyway.
INPERSON.Panel.UnmeasuredTooltip: This many files of the scene have no known size yet. They are missing from the total on the left. Click "Measure" to fill them in.
INPERSON.Panel.MeasureHint: Click "Measure" so this shows real figures instead of an incomplete total.
INPERSON.Panel.MonitorProtected: Protected: this account shows the map on the TV and never enters table mode automatically. Only "Always" overrides that.
INPERSON.Notify.NoScene: No active scene, nothing to measure.
INPERSON.Notify.Measured: Scene measured: {size} per client ({measured} files, {missing} without a size header).
INPERSON.Notify.MeasureFailed: Measuring failed - see the console for details.
INPERSON.Notify.RefreshSent: All connected clients were asked to re-apply their state.
INPERSON.Notify.CanvasDisabled: Table Mode switched the game canvas off on this device.
INPERSON.Notify.CanvasRestored: Table Mode released the game canvas on this device.
INPERSON.Settings.MonitorRelease.Name: When a display is released
INPERSON.Settings.MonitorRelease.Hint: What a display does once its pin is lifted. Without this choice it would sit on the pinned scene until the next activation happens to come along.
INPERSON.Settings.MonitorRelease.Follow: Move to the active scene and follow again
INPERSON.Panel.RolePinnedTip: Stays on its scene until you send it somewhere explicitly.
INPERSON.Notify.NoIdleScene: No idle scene chosen - the display follows the active scene instead.
INPERSON.Notify.DisplayKeptBack: {who} is pinned and was left behind. Use "Bring players here" to take it along on purpose.
INPERSON.Panel.IdleSceneUnused: Currently unused: the module setting "When a display is released" is set to "Move to the active scene".
INPERSON.Settings.MonitorBM.Name: Battlemap display
INPERSON.Settings.MonitorBM.Hint: The screen with the map. It follows every scene change and is exempt from table mode.
INPERSON.Settings.MonitorSC.Name: Scene display
INPERSON.Settings.MonitorSC.Hint: The screen for pictures and companion scenes. It can be held on one scene.
INPERSON.Settings.MonitorScCombat.Name: The map's combat on the scene display
INPERSON.Settings.MonitorScCombat.Hint: Shows the combat bar of the active map on the scene display too, although it shows another scene.
INPERSON.Setup.MenuHint: What your table uses and how: displays, table mode, sheet view, time & weather, trading and the premium add-ons.
INPERSON.Setup.Funktionen.Hint: Choose what your table uses. Every feature you switch on gets a tab of its own at the top, with everything that belongs to it.
INPERSON.Setup.Feat.MonitoreFor: Two screens at the table: one shows the map, one shows pictures and scenes to go with it. You steer what is seen where.
INPERSON.Setup.Wer.MonitoreHint: Each display logs in with a player account of its own. Enter which one here.
INPERSON.Setup.Wer.TischHint: As a default for all players, and below it differently for single ones.
INPERSON.Setup.Wer.BlattHint: Tick the players who should see only their character sheet on their device.
INPERSON.Setup.Was.TischHint: How much a device leaves out in table mode.
INPERSON.Setup.VerhaltenHint: How the sheet feels on the tablet.
INPERSON.Setup.ZeigenHint: Players can show their sheet or a picture to the others.
INPERSON.Setup.AlteGeraeteHint: Only needed when a tablet cannot keep up.
INPERSON.Setup.Zeit.WasHint: Each can be switched on and off separately.
INPERSON.Setup.Prem.Hint: These features come with the add-on In-Person Tools Premium. It is for supporters on Patreon.
INPERSON.Setup.Prem.Szene: Set per scene in the In-Person tab.
INPERSON.Setup.Prem.BuehneFor: Whole performances on the scene display, such as the character reveal with cards, effects and the card flight.
INPERSON.Setup.Prem.BlendeFor: The players' devices show black and a logo until you uncover them, all at once or one by one.
INPERSON.Setup.Prem.TonFor: Choose which computer the speaker hangs on, control the display's volume, and the mouse pointer disappears there by itself.
INPERSON.Setup.Prem.GleichlaufFor: A film on the display and its music start together on the dot.
INPERSON.Setup.Card.TischmodusFor: For tablets and weak devices at the table: they stop loading the maps, since the map is on the television anyway. Only needed when players sit at the table with devices of their own.
INPERSON.Setup.Card.BlattFor: A player sees only their character sheet on their device, without Foundry's interface. For tablets that serve as nothing but a character sheet at the table.
INPERSON.Setup.Card.LeisteFor: A slim bar above the character sheet with the date, time, sky and weather of the game world. Visible in the sheet view and in Sheet Only.
INPERSON.Setup.Card.SzeneFor: What the scene display shows when you activate a map, and where it goes when you release it.
INPERSON.Setup.Card.SchonerFor: Protects an OLED television from burn-in: when the same picture stands too long, the scene display goes black for a while or shows other scenes.
INPERSON.Setup.Title: Set up In-Person
INPERSON.Setup.Konten.VorgabeHint: Applies to every player set to "As set by default" below.
INPERSON.Setup.Ton.Hint: Where the sound goes and how loud it is on the displays.
INPERSON.Setup.Buehne.Hint: The stages for the scene display and the cover for the players' devices.
INPERSON.Settings.CompanionRedirect.Name: Activating a companion loads its map
INPERSON.Settings.CompanionRedirect.Hint: Activate a companion scene, and its map is activated instead while the companion goes to the scene display. If it has music of its own, that plays.
INPERSON.Redirect.ChooseText: "{scene}" is a companion of several maps. Which one should be activated?
INPERSON.Notify.NoSceneDisplay: No scene display chosen. Pick an account under "Scene display" in the module settings.
INPERSON.Panel.UnpairTip: Remove all companions of this battlemap
INPERSON.SceneConfig.RotationHint: Rotates the whole view of this scene, for everyone who sees it. Meant for maps drawn portrait that should lie across the width of a 16:9 screen. Note: the token HUD turns with it and will sit sideways too.
INPERSON.SceneConfig.LockViewCorrected: Lock View detected: its "{mode}" fitting and the viewbox are turned along with this scene.
INPERSON.SceneConfig.LockViewViewboxOnly: Lock View detected: the viewbox is turned along with this scene. The fitting needs no correction.
INPERSON.SceneConfig.LockViewOffset: Lock View detected, but this scene excludes the sidebar or the AV dock from the view. Those offsets are measured on screen and are not turned along, so the viewbox stays slightly off while the scene is rotated.
INPERSON.SceneConfig.CompanionsLegend: Companion scenes for the scene display
INPERSON.SceneConfig.CompanionsHint: When this scene is activated, the scene display switches to the first one, even while pinned. The others you bring onto the display during play from the small companion bar at the edge of your screen. Meant for battlemaps with matching scene views: the floors of a tower, day and night, inside and out.
INPERSON.SceneConfig.NoScreensaverHint: As long as the scene display shows this scene, the screensaver does not start, neither the cover nor its own scenes, and the map setting below does not apply either. For intros and scenes with a film that should run through. The time keeps running; another scene starts it over.
INPERSON.SceneConfig.ScreensaverModeDefa: As set for the scene displays
INPERSON.SceneConfig.ScreensaverMinutesH: How long the same picture stays. Left empty, the scene displays' time applies ({minuten} minutes).
INPERSON.SceneConfig.ScreensaverHint: Applies while this map is active and the scene display shows it or one of its companions, even when the screensaver is otherwise off. When taking turns, the next companion marked in the list above comes up after the time. Scenes left out are still companions: you send them to the display from the companion bar, and after the time the turns carry on from there.
INPERSON.SceneList.DropHint: Drag a scene here from the sidebar
INPERSON.SceneList.FirstTip: The scene display jumps to this one when the battlemap is activated.
INPERSON.SceneList.RotatesTip: Comes up when the companions take turns. Click to leave it out.
INPERSON.SceneList.SkippedTip: Left out of the turns, but still a companion. Click to include it.
INPERSON.Keybind.Begleitwahl.Name: Switch companion scenes
INPERSON.Keybind.Begleitwahl.Hint: Opens the overview of the companion scenes of the active battlemap. No key by default. Gamemasters only.
INPERSON.Begleitwahl.Title: Companion scenes
INPERSON.Begleitwahl.NoMap: No scene is active right now.
INPERSON.Begleitwahl.NoDisplay: No scene display is set up. Choose its account in the display settings.
INPERSON.Begleitwahl.Offline: The scene display is not logged in right now.
INPERSON.Begleitwahl.FromDefault: This map has no companions of its own. Shown here is the default companion scene.
INPERSON.Begleitwahl.None: This map has no companion scenes. Add them in its scene configuration, on the "In-Person" tab.
INPERSON.Begleitleiste.ScreensaverStart: Start the screensaver on the scene display now
INPERSON.Begleitleiste.ScreensaverStop: End the screensaver, the scene comes back
INPERSON.Begleitleiste.Label: Switch companion scenes
INPERSON.Keybind.Ebenen.Name: Level of the battlemap display
INPERSON.Keybind.Ebenen.Hint: Opens the controls for which level the battlemap display shows. Gamemasters only.
INPERSON.Ebenen.Title: Level of the battlemap display
INPERSON.Ebenen.ModeLabel: How the display picks its level
INPERSON.Ebenen.Mode.autonomHint: In combat, where a player character has the turn. Otherwise the level of the player character you last selected. Until you select one on this map, where most of them stand.
INPERSON.Ebenen.Mode.foundryHint: As without this module: the display follows every observed token that changes level.
INPERSON.Ebenen.Mode.manuellHint: The level you tap below. For the moment only: it goes back to Automatic as soon as you select a player character or activate another map.
INPERSON.Ebenen.FixedElsewhere: The chosen level belongs to another map. Here the display picks as in Automatic.
INPERSON.Ebenen.FixedNoSight: No token the display may see through stands on the chosen level. Rather than show a black picture, it follows the party until someone is there again.
INPERSON.Ebenen.NoScene: No scene is active right now
INPERSON.Ebenen.SingleLevel: The active map has a single level. There is nothing to choose here.
INPERSON.Ebenen.PickTip: Show this level on the display
INPERSON.Ebenen.NoSightTip: No token stands on this level that the display may see through. It would show a black picture there.
INPERSON.Ebenen.RoofHint: As at your desk over the selected token, only over every player character. Foundry never opens them on the display, because it owns no token.
INPERSON.Ebenen.Missing: {monitor} may not observe these player characters and so does not see through their eyes:
INPERSON.Ebenen.NoDisplay: No battlemap display is set up. Choose its account in the display settings.
INPERSON.Ebenen.Offline: {monitor} is not logged in right now. What you set here applies once it is back.
INPERSON.Pull.Title: Bring players
INPERSON.Pull.NobodyOnline: Nobody except you is connected right now.
INPERSON.Notify.Migrated: Carried over from the previous version: {settings} settings, {scenes} scenes.
INPERSON.Notify.DefaultCompanionSet: "{scene}" is now the default companion scene.
INPERSON.Panel.DefaultCompanionTip: What the scene display shows when an activated map has no companion of its own. Left empty, it shows the same map as the battlemap display.
INPERSON.Settings.IdleAfter.Name: Change the picture after ... minutes of the same one
INPERSON.Settings.IdleAfter.Hint: How long the same picture may stand before the screensaver steps in. A new picture starts the time over. Single scenes are exempted in their In-Person tab.
INPERSON.Settings.IdleFolder.Name: Screensaver folder
INPERSON.Settings.IdleFolder.Hint: The scenes of this folder are shown one after another. Without a folder and without a scene only the black cover remains.
INPERSON.Settings.IdleScene.None: None, drag a scene here from the sidebar to set one
INPERSON.Settings.IdleScene.Hint: A single scene that takes turns with the actual one. Takes precedence over the folder.
INPERSON.Settings.IdleScene.Name: Or a single scene
INPERSON.Settings.IdleRotate.Name: Change scene every ... minutes
INPERSON.Settings.IdleRotate.Hint: With a folder: the gap between two of its scenes. With a single scene: how long it stays before the real scene comes back.
INPERSON.Settings.IdleBlankFor.Name: Cover stays for ... minutes
INPERSON.Settings.IdleBlankFor.Hint: After that the scene is visible again until the waiting time has run out once more.
INPERSON.Settings.IdleLogo.Name: Image on the cover
INPERSON.Settings.IdleLogo.Hint: Drifts slowly across the black. Without one a small gold dot appears instead, so the screen does not look broken.
INPERSON.Displays.PairsHint: Which map has which companion scenes. The scene display jumps to the first, in bold, on activation. The same is set on the map in its In-Person tab.
INPERSON.Settings.KeepTokens.Name: Keep loading token artwork
INPERSON.Settings.KeepTokens.Hint: Recommended. Without them the tokens are black on the device.
INPERSON.Settings.HideProgress.Name: Hide the loading bar
INPERSON.Settings.HideProgress.Hint: Hides Foundry's loading bar for players and on the displays. It names the scene being loaded and so gives away what comes next.
INPERSON.Settings.ShowPill.Name: This device: status badge
INPERSON.Settings.ShowPill.Hint: Small badge along the bottom edge of a player's screen while table mode runs there. It explains that the black map is deliberate.
INPERSON.Settings.ForeignWindows.Name: Keep other windows on screen too
INPERSON.Settings.ForeignWindows.Hint: Windows from other modules and the system are capped to the screen when they run past it. Otherwise a tablet leaves you with neither an edge to drag nor a close button. Nothing is ever made larger. When Ninjo's DnD Shops & Trade is installed as well, this setting is the one in charge.
INPERSON.Settings.IdleEnabled.Name: Use a screensaver
INPERSON.Settings.IdleEnabled.Hint: For displays on an OLED. With this off nothing happens at all - everything below appears only once you say yes here.
INPERSON.Settings.IdleMode.Name: Which kind
INPERSON.Settings.IdleMode.Hint: The black cover spares an OLED the most. The scene change is for tables that would rather look at something.
INPERSON.Settings.IdleMode.Cover: Lay a black cover over the current scene
INPERSON.Displays.TestCoverHint: Shows the cover here for a few seconds. A click or a key ends it.
INPERSON.SceneField.Empty: None — drag a scene here from the sidebar to set one
INPERSON.SceneField.NotAScene: That was not a scene. Only entries from the scene sidebar can be dropped here.
INPERSON.SceneField.NotItself: A scene cannot be its own companion.
INPERSON.Displays.PairNeedsBoth: Choose both sides: the battlemap first, then the scene the display should show alongside it.
INPERSON.Settings.ActorPanel.Name: Replace Sheet Only's actor selector
INPERSON.Settings.ActorPanel.Hint: In sheet-only mode, replaces the selector button with an actor directory that docks to the right edge; the character sheet makes room for it. Requires the "Sheet Only" module and has no effect without it.
INPERSON.Settings.ClockStrip.Name: Date and time in sheet-only mode
INPERSON.Settings.ClockStrip.Hint: Shows a slim strip with the date and time while only the character sheet is visible. There is no Foundry interface left in that mode, and so no calendar HUD either. Applies to this device only.
INPERSON.Settings.ClockWeather.Name: Include weather and season
INPERSON.Settings.ClockWeather.Hint: Adds the season to the strip and, where there is one, the current weather with its temperature. The season is read from the world calendar and needs nothing else - Foundry's own calendar is enough. The weather comes from Calendaria; without it that part is simply left out.
INPERSON.Settings.Trade.Name: Trading between players
INPERSON.Settings.Trade.Hint: A trade button for the players: two put items and money on a table, and only when both agree is anything exchanged.
INPERSON.Clock.NoWeatherSource: No weather module active - has no effect for now.
INPERSON.TradeSettings.ItemPiles: Item Piles is active. Turn its trade button off, or two will sit side by side.
INPERSON.Willkommen.Einleitung: Tools for groups playing around one table. Player tablets stop downloading battlemaps, two displays can be steered separately, and portrait maps lie down flat.
INPERSON.Willkommen.Punkt1: Table mode — keeps map downloads off the players' devices. Measured: one "preload scene" transferred 58.86 MB, and 0.00 MB with table mode on.
INPERSON.Willkommen.Punkt2: Scene displays — two display accounts with separate jobs: one follows every scene, one can be pinned. Plus burn-in protection for the television.
INPERSON.Willkommen.Punkt3: On the character sheet — together with Sheet Only, the date, time and weather appear where there is otherwise no interface left.
INPERSON.Willkommen.Start: To begin: Shift+T opens the control panel with the master switch. Everything else lives in the module settings under "Table Mode" and "Scene Displays".
INPERSON.Willkommen.Untertitel: Tools for playing around a real table
INPERSON.Willkommen.ForgeZeile: Every module, its documentation and the German translations in one place: open the module page
INPERSON.Willkommen.PatreonZeile: The modules are free and stay free. On Patreon you can support my work and get premium add-ons in return.
INPERSON.Clock.Field.SkyHint: Shows where the sun or moon stands right now, with the moon's phase. Computed from the world calendar; without those figures it falls back to 06:00/18:00.
INPERSON.Clock.SunGuessed: estimated - the calendar gives no figures
INPERSON.SheetView.Name: Sheet view (beta)
INPERSON.SheetView.Hint: Gives players the whole screen for their character sheet and replaces Foundry's interface with a bar of a few large buttons. For tablets at the table. Beta: switch it on while you are there - gamemasters are never affected.
INPERSON.SheetView.NoSheet: The sheet of {name} cannot be opened - you lack permission on this character.
INPERSON.SheetView.NoFullscreen: This device does not allow fullscreen. On iPhone and iPad, use “Add to Home Screen”.
INPERSON.SheetView.NoUsers: There are no player accounts yet.
INPERSON.SheetView.OldIpadHint: For iPads on iPadOS 17 and older that get stuck while loading: the canvas is switched off before Foundry draws the first scene.
INPERSON.SheetView.DeviceReportHint: For troubleshooting: each player device keeps the errors of its first ten minutes, with browser and screen size. Input and content are not collected.
INPERSON.SheetView.NoCanvasHint: The tablet stops rendering scenes altogether - the same machinery as table mode. The device asks once to reload.
INPERSON.SheetView.ChatOnUse: Open the chat on a roll
INPERSON.SheetView.ChatOnUseHint: As soon as the player rolls or uses something themselves, the chat opens so they see the result. Other people's rolls open nothing.
INPERSON.SheetView.ShowAllowHint: A player can show a journal page of their own to the others at the table while their window is open. No permissions are granted.
INPERSON.SheetView.ShowTvHint: Adds the scene display to the list of recipients. The battlemap display stays out of it: a letter does not belong on top of the fight.
INPERSON.SheetView.ShowGmCopyHint: Every showing produces a whispered line in chat, for the gamemaster only. They know what is being passed around without having a window forced on them.
INPERSON.Show.Title: Show
INPERSON.Show.Hint: Whoever sees this may read it while the window is open. They cannot keep it.
INPERSON.Show.Nobody: Nobody else is in the game.
INPERSON.Show.OfferTitle: Somebody wants to show you something
INPERSON.Show.OfferText: {von} would like to show you something.
INPERSON.SheetView.EditPenHint: A tablet has no mouse pointer, so the pen for editing a journal page would never appear. Switched on, it is always there.
INPERSON.SheetView.ResetHint: Reset this account's bars to their defaults - position, size, text size, on all of its devices. A device that is off catches up on its next load.
INPERSON.SheetView.ResetDone: {name}: bars are being reset to their defaults.
INPERSON.Clock.Field.SkySourceHint: The module's own dome runs on every tablet. Calendaria's is prettier but needs a stronger device.
INPERSON.Clock.Field.SkyTimes: Sunrise and sunset in the tooltip
INPERSON.Clock.Field.SkyTimesHint: A tap on the dome shows when the sun rises and sets. Off means: the players see only where sun and moon stand.
INPERSON.Clock.Field.MotionHint: Rain, snow and clouds move. "As the device says" follows its reduced motion setting, "Always" overrides it.
INPERSON.Trade.Moved.Title: The trade has moved
INPERSON.Trade.Moved.Text: Trading between two people now lives in Ninjo's DnD Shops & Trade — on the same table it uses for trading with merchants. Once that module is installed and enabled, this button opens it.
INPERSON.TradeSettings.Moved: The trade itself runs through Ninjo's DnD Shops & Trade. Everything else is set there.
INPERSON.TradeSettings.MovedMissing: The trade itself lives in Ninjo's DnD Shops & Trade — that module is not enabled right now. The button will only say where the function went.
